changelog: - **Meetings, meeting series, contributor terms, note conversion and the project group chat stay inside the caller's tenant** (#2627, follow-up to #2622). With `MT_ENFORCE_ISOLATION` off the org middleware scopes nothing and these routes took a project (or relation) id with an ADMIN bypass and no tenant check, so another tenant's admin could start an instant meeting for a foreign project or relation (mailing and notifying its members), list/create/edit/delete a foreign project's meeting series, record a project-bound contributor-terms acceptance for it (and read 404 vs 409 as an existence oracle), and turn a line of their own note into a task on a foreign project or a goal on a foreign relation. Each now asks `projectInCallerTenant()` (or ANDs `tenantWhere(session)` for relations) and answers like a missing one. The project group chat was gated only on a `ProjectMember` row, which carries no org, so a cross-tenant membership opened another tenant's room (roster, history, posting); the new `groupRoomOpensFor()` asks the tenant first for `getConversationIfAllowed`, `canPostToConversation` and `POST /api/conversations`, and the two `/api/messages/[id]/**` callers that hand-built `{ id, role }` now pass `session.user` so their `orgId` is read. New `e2e/cross-tenant-project-satellites.spec.ts` (12 probes, verified failing on the previous code; an in-tenant control proves the owners keep access).
